text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Given that it's Valentine's Day, I'd like
you to
have this.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I suspected you'd be surprised. I
suppose it stands
to reason, as I'm
unaccustomed to Valentine's
traditions.
choice_data_list: えっ！？用意してくれたの？

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That said...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: If you want to show someone how you feel, it's super important to choose just the right chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Including an extra present on top of that
might
also be a nice way to add a
special touch.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You've also gotta make sure the
chocolates are
different from the ones
you give everyone else,
so the person
knows they're special! That's a
romance
comic staple!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, can I borrow you for a
minute—hey, what
are you reading?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! I-I'll be there in a sec!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Valentine's Day is an occasion for
sharing your
feelings with the person you
hold dear."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Give that special someone some special

chocolates to show them how you feel!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hm, so that's the idea behind giving
chocolates. I
see...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You are very special to me, Trainer. I
must take
this opportunity to convey my
feelings of
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Wh-when I say "special," I mean as my
trainer, of
course!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, but I don't mean that our
relationship is
exclusively work-based! I
have great affection for
you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um... Well, put simply...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm e-especially grateful to have you in
my life!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her words come out somewhat jumbled,
but
Yaeno Muteki's gratitude comes
through loud
and clear.
choice_data_list: ありがとう！すっごく嬉しい！！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: R-really? That is fortunate...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inside the package are some chocolates
and a
baby animal photobook.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I chose the chocolates carefully, but I
wasn't sure
what else you might like...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So I thought to give you the photobook
I carry
with me every day.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Observing weak and vulnerable
creatures helps
me reconnect with the
true essence of the Kongo
Yaegaki
style—the spirit of protection.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The book also soothes my soul. I
guarantee you'll
find it a comfort.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So that's why she gave me her beloved

photobook.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
By the way, that's the sixth volume—the
very
latest. It's even newer than the one
I have.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh! I'd be delighted!
choice_data_list: まだ読んでないなら、一緒に読まない？

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! They're adorable... Those teeny
pink paw
pads... They're utterly helpless!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a moment! Let me spend just a
little more
time with this kitten...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
We have the time, so let's enjoy it at our
leisure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere is warm and cozy as
Yaeno
Muteki and I enjoy a blissful
moment admiring the
pictures of cute
animals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inside the package are some chocolates
and a
small, cuddly teddy bear.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I chose the chocolates carefully, but I
wasn't sure
what else you might like...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So I thought I'd make you something
myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I did. Sewing a plushie is quite similar to
mending
clothes, so I had some
experience to draw on.
choice_data_list: このぬいぐるみ、作ったの！？

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And... I designed it to match the bear I
have in my
room.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's an adorable little thing I received
from my
grandparents. It's very precious
to me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When I was wondering what to give you,
I
remembered how happy I was when I
got that
bear.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That's why I tried to make yours look the
same.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I was wrong to give you
something just
because I liked it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give the little stuffed toy a gentle
squeeze. Its
lopsided ears give it a real
handmade charm.
choice_data_list: いいや、嬉しい！大切に可愛がるよ！
ううん、嬉しいよ！大切に可愛がるね！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'd like to offer you a piece of
advice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That bear is very much like a part of me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So feel free to give it some attention on

occasions when I happen to be absent.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That said, at this very moment, I'm right
here in
front of you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To WHAT?!
choice_data_list: つまり、ヤエノも撫でられたいのか……？
つまり、ヤエノも撫でられたいの……？

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what are you saying, all of a
sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's not at all what I mean!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... My lack of familiarity with events
like this
has thrown my composure off!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm suddenly painfully aware of my
inexperience!
Argh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This Valentine's Day, not only do I get
chocolates
and a gift, but I even get a
glimpse of an
expression I've never seen
on Yaeno Muteki's
face before.
